name: GitHub Actions TestOps bounded workflow-run pagination
$limitation: This plan proves the Go complete-route default accepts a third in-window GitHub Actions page and still rejects an advertised page beyond the bounded 10,000-run maximum. It does not prove provider-side run ordering, per-run job/artifact pagination, report parsing, or the Python adapter's independent pagination behavior.

mutations.rationale: The default must not retain the two-page 200-run ceiling: a configured backfill can contain more than 200 in-window workflow runs.
If GitHub advertises a workflow-run page beyond the bounded maximum, the unit must fail before effects or a watermark can be committed.
